correctness.rationale: In real dimension two, two identical Parseval continuous fusion frames with counting measure on two atoms and coordinate-line components are woven with sharp bounds (1,1). Intersecting all with W=span(e1+e2) gives zero components and no lower bound. The source Theorem 2.2 of Sadri–Ahmadi–Rahimlou, arXiv:1901.03799, incorrectly uses P_M P_W=P_{M∩W}, which fails for these noncommuting orthogonal projections. Commutation suffices to restore original weaving bounds. Exact 2x2 matrices and the primary source theorem/proof were inspected; universal counterexample valid.
